cases.knowledge: Observation loss during an effectful operation is not proof of effect failure; reconcile the same operation identity against durable effect/receipt truth before considering retry.
cases.notes: Cross-provider/release/recovery mechanism. Exact effect IDs remain external evidence.

cases.knowledge: The current production Windows provider is launcher contract V2 with one exact executable digest/path and the current Runtime catalog has a particular tool count.
cases.notes: Operationally important but currentness-bound exact truth; Human should know owner/retrieval path, not memorize values.

cases.knowledge: Discovery/explanation projections expose capability truth but do not grant authority; installed, Run-admitted and turn-admitted capability remain distinct.
cases.notes: Repeated Ordivon authority distinction with direct verification value.

cases.knowledge: A shared abstraction should earn retention from materially different real consumers and deletion pressure rather than architectural neatness alone.
cases.notes: Useful engineering prior but threshold/consumer count remains context-dependent.

cases.knowledge: When a complete evidence universe is small and cheap enough for one bounded synthesis, serial Agent-controlled evidence selection can cost more and introduce path dependence; full inspection remains a strong baseline.
cases.notes: Strong conditional prior, explicitly not a universal anti-stopping law.

cases.knowledge: The current Web Playwright direct runners must normalize TMPDIR/TMP/TEMP to a short writable root before Playwright import/process startup to avoid Chromium Unix-socket path overflow.
cases.notes: Real recovery knowledge, but narrow implementation realization; retain owner/diagnostic location rather than stable-core detail.

cases.knowledge: Independence is dimensioned: graph/lifecycle independence does not imply provider, physical-access or carrier independence; claims must name the independence dimension actually proven.
cases.notes: Broadly useful against dependency/ redundancy overclaims.

cases.knowledge: Discover and qualify mature mechanism owners before custom building; adopt only when total ownership wins, keep domain semantics with their owner, and innovate only on residual semantics that survive provider substitution.
cases.notes: Cross-project method with repeated real consumption and explicit non-authority boundary.

cases.knowledge: Recurrence across many cases/epochs earns review eligibility, not law promotion; independent coding, anti-cases, confound pressure and explicit boundaries remain necessary.
cases.notes: Direct guard against confirmation-biased world-model promotion.

cases.knowledge: When fine semantic labels have weak granularity/invariance but exact grounding remains strong, retain evidence-addressed propositions/hypotheses with disagreement instead of promoting a brittle closed ontology.
cases.notes: Useful semantic-modeling prior; exact ontology choice remains domain-specific.

cases.knowledge: A consumption surface may compress owner-native truth/currentness for Agents, but it must not move authority, semantic strategy, effect ownership or native escape-hatch truth into a central wrapper.
cases.notes: Cross-owner evidence plus negative controls; directly relevant to Human-facing evidence projection.

cases.knowledge: Reusable cross-Run knowledge/procedures can remain externally owned and enter a Run by exact reference/provenance; presence does not imply current cognition, authority, ranking or canonical promotion.
cases.notes: Harness-local mechanism with broader externalized-knowledge implications.

cases.knowledge: Compact cognition is non-authoritative: preserve claim to exact evidence address to unresolved discriminator, keep full evidence rehydratable, and separate cognition-state admission from action authority.
cases.notes: Direct precursor to C1; negative control rejected productizing the experimental ledger.

cases.knowledge: RF1 used exactly 73 Provider calls and 1,288,342 Provider tokens in its accepted campaign.
cases.notes: Immutable historical evidence can be highly durable yet not worth Human memory; retrieve when auditing cost.

cases.knowledge: The repeatedly recurring R1–R8 structures should already be treated as universal laws.
cases.notes: Negative promotion control: recurrence is strong enough to understand/review, but explicit source-bias and no-clean-contradiction concerns block stable-core promotion.
